say: Monday night, in Saint-Denis.
Stop the presses.

beats.headline:
Four in
fourteen
beats.deck: Belgium led for 42 minutes. Then Zidane's substitutes scored four times in the last fourteen.
beats.note: All four goals came from the bench.
say: Here's tomorrow's front page, tonight. Four-one to France.
Belgium led for forty-two minutes. Then Zidane's substitutes scored four times in fourteen minutes.

beats.title: The bench strikes back
beats.byline: By cmvng · Stade de France, Saint-Denis
body: Dodi Lukébakio put Belgium ahead after 35 minutes with a left-footed shot from 22 metres, and Belgium held on while France pushed.
Zinédine Zidane had promised changes. On the hour he sent on Michael Olise and Rayan Cherki; on 72 minutes, Désiré Doué.
Doué levelled on 77. Cherki scored on 81. Olise scored on 88, and again in stoppage time.
say: Lukébakio put Belgium ahead after thirty-five minutes, from twenty-two metres, and Belgium held on.
Zidane had promised changes. On the hour, he sent on Olise and Cherki. Then Doué.
Doué levelled on seventy-seven. Cherki scored on eighty-one. And Olise scored twice at the death.

beats.title: Doué, off the bench
beats.text: On the pitch for five minutes, Désiré Doué levelled with his left foot from 18 metres.
say: The turning point: seventy-seven minutes.
Désiré Doué had been on the pitch for five minutes.
Left foot, from eighteen metres. One all.

beats.title: The numbers
beats.note: Belgium's keeper made five saves. France kept coming.
say: Twenty-four shots to five. Nine on target to two.
Belgium's keeper made five saves, and France kept coming.
This morning, we wrote: a narrow France win, few goals, and one-nil the likeliest score.
France won it. Narrow, it was not.
Half right.

items.text: Calafiori and Pio Esposito, both on at 55 minutes, scored after Şimşir's equaliser. Italy go second.
Gyökeres scored after 13 minutes: seven Nations League games in a row with a goal.
Yaremchuk headed Ukraine level on 83. Two minutes later, Csinger won it for Hungary.

say: In Bologna, Italy beat Türkiye three-one, with two more goals from the bench, from Calafiori and Pio Esposito. Called it.
In Bucharest, Viktor Gyökeres scored again: seven Nations League games in a row. Sweden win, one-nil. Called it.
And in Trnava, Hungary won two-one, with the winner on eighty-five minutes. We had a Ukrainian edge. Wrong.

beats.title: Group 1
beats.sub: France three points clear; Italy climb above Belgium.
points: Only the top two reach the March quarter-finals
say: France go three points clear at the top. Italy climb above Belgium, into second.
Two matchdays left.
And only the top two reach the quarter-finals.
That's tomorrow's paper. Follow for the next edition.
